user.title: Setup Mode
user.description: Choose your audio setup mode. Camera feed selection is configured separately in the next steps.

reolink.title: Reolink Audio Device
reolink.description: Select which Reolink integration should provide two-way audio. This does not need to match your camera feed entity.

manual_audio.title: Manual Audio Setup
manual_audio.description: Choose manual audio wiring: either an external go2rtc stream or Home Assistant speaker/microphone entities.

provider.title: AI Provider
provider.description: Configure the AI model that will power your doorbell concierge. For **Gemini**, use the native audio dialog model. For **OpenAI**, any realtime-capable model works. You can also use local models with an OpenAI-compatible API by setting the Base URL.

data.api_base_url: API Base URL (optional, for local/custom models)

camera.title: Camera & Vision
camera.description: Configure the camera feed and how often video frames are sent to the AI model. This camera is independent from the audio device.

prompt.title: System Prompt
prompt.description: Define the AI agent's personality and rules. This is the core instruction set that governs how Jeeves behaves, greets visitors, and makes decisions.

triggers_setup.title: Triggers
triggers_setup.description: Choose which entities start Jeeves automatically and which entities stop the session.

camera_map.title: Camera Map
camera_map.description: Manage spatial camera placements used for property awareness and PTZ navigation. {camera_summary}

add_camera_placement.title: Add Camera Placement
add_camera_placement.description: Map a camera to the property layout. Re-adding the same camera updates its placement.

remove_camera_placement.title: Remove Camera Placement
remove_camera_placement.description: Select a mapped camera to remove from the property layout.

task_instructions.title: Task Instructions
task_instructions.description: Manage extra prompt instructions appended to Jeeves for specific duties. {instruction_summary}

add_task_instruction.title: Add Task Instruction
add_task_instruction.description: Add or replace a titled instruction block appended to the system prompt.

error.invalid_api_key: Could not validate the API key. Please check it and try again.
error.no_reolink_found: No active Reolink integrations found. Please set up your Reolink doorbell in Home Assistant first.
error.invalid_speaker_entity: Speaker must be a valid media_player entity.
error.invalid_microphone_entity: Microphone must be a valid assist_satellite or media_player entity.

general.title: General Settings
general.description: Configure the AI provider, model, and session behavior. The Text Model is used for memory recaps and summaries (required when the voice model is audio-only).

dual_model.title: Dual Model Architecture
dual_model.description:
By default, the voice model handles tool calls natively (recommended). Enable dual-model mode only if you want a separate text model to handle tool execution instead of the voice model.

This is an advanced option — most users should leave it disabled.

data.tool_api_key: Tool Model API Key (blank = same as voice)

vision.title: Camera & Vision
vision.description: Configure the camera feed sent to the AI. Lower resolution and FPS reduce token costs and improve response time.

audio.title: Audio Setup
audio.description: Choose the audio mode to configure.

audio_reolink.title: Reolink Audio Setup
audio_reolink.description: Select which Reolink integration entry should provide two-way audio.

audio_manual.title: Manual Audio Setup
audio_manual.description: Configure manual audio routing through an external go2rtc stream or Home Assistant entities.

timeline.title: Timeline Integration
timeline.description:
Connect Jeeves to LLM Vision timeline events so the assistant can answer questions about recent detections.

LLM Vision status: {status}

entities.title: Entities & Actions
entities.description: Manage the entities and actions available to the AI agent. {entity_summary}

add_camera.title: Add Camera
add_camera.description: Add a camera the AI can view on demand. When a visitor asks about something (e.g., 'is my ball in your garden?'), the AI can check this camera live.

data.name: Camera Name (for AI, e.g., 'Garden Camera')
data.description: Description (e.g., 'Shows the back garden and lawn area')

add_calendar.title: Add Calendar
add_calendar.description: Add a calendar so the AI can check schedules. When asked about availability (e.g., 'will you be home tomorrow?'), the AI reads this calendar.

data.name: Calendar Name (e.g., 'Owner's Work Schedule')
data.description: Description (e.g., 'Main work and personal calendar — use to determine availability')

add_entity.title: Add Managed Entity
add_entity.description: Add an entity that the AI can see and optionally control. The description tells the AI what this entity is and how to use it.

remove_entity.title: Remove Managed Entity
remove_entity.description: Select an entity to remove from AI access.

add_action.title: Add Action
add_action.description: Create a custom action the AI can perform. Choose either a managed entity action or an existing automation trigger.

data.action_description: Description (tells AI when to use this)

add_notification.title: Add Notification Target
add_notification.description: Add a notification service the AI can use to alert you (e.g., push notification, alarm).

data.name: Display Name (e.g., Admin Phone)
data.description: Description (tells AI when to use this)

add_audio_file.title: Add Audio File
add_audio_file.description:
Add an audio file the AI agent can play over speakers or cameras.

For **Media ID**, use a Home Assistant media source path like:
`media-source://media_source/local/sounds/scream.mp3`
or a direct URL like `http://example.com/sound.mp3`

data.name: Sound Name (e.g. Scary Scream)
data.description: Description for the AI (e.g. A loud scream, good for scaring trick-or-treaters)

security.title: Security Settings
security.description: Configure global security defaults. Per-entity and per-action overrides are configured in the Entities section.

triggers.title: Triggers & Human Takeover
triggers.description:
Configure which entities trigger the AI session and how to detect when a human takes over.

**Start triggers** automatically activate Jeeves (e.g., doorbell press).
**Stop triggers** end the session (e.g., front door opens).
**Human takeover** stops the AI when you start talking via the Reolink app or another method.

data.stop_entities: Stop Trigger Entities (e.g., front door sensor)
data.takeover_reolink_api: Reolink API Takeover Detection (polls camera talk state)
data.takeover_audio_energy: Audio Energy Takeover Detection (monitors mic loudness)

identities.title: Known Identities
identities.description: Manage known people, animals, and objects that the AI should recognize. {identity_summary}

add_identity.title: Add Known Identity
add_identity.description: Add a person, animal, or object for the AI to recognize. Provide a clear physical description and optionally a reference image URL or local path.

data.name: Name
data.reference_image: Reference Image (URL, local path, or base64)

identity_settings.title: Identity Detection Settings
identity_settings.description: Choose how the AI identifies visitors. You can use an external face recognition sensor (like Frigate), reference images sent to the AI model, or both.

prompt.title: System Prompt
prompt.description: Edit the AI agent's core instructions. This defines personality, rules, and behavior boundaries.

edit_entity.title: Edit Managed Entity
edit_entity.description: Select an entity to edit, then update its current values. Existing actions are preserved.

edit_action.title: Edit Action
edit_action.description: Select any configured action, then update its current definition and optional extra steps.

add_standalone_action.title: Add Standalone Action
add_standalone_action.description: Create an action that is not tied to one managed entity. Useful for scenes, scripts, or grouped actions.

camera_map.title: Camera Map
camera_map.description: Manage spatial camera placements used for property awareness and PTZ navigation. {camera_summary}

add_camera_placement.title: Add Camera Placement
add_camera_placement.description: Map a camera to the property layout. Re-adding the same camera updates its placement.

remove_camera_placement.title: Remove Camera Placement
remove_camera_placement.description: Select a mapped camera to remove from the property layout.

task_instructions.title: Task Instructions
task_instructions.description: Manage extra prompt instructions appended to Jeeves for specific duties. {instruction_summary}

add_task_instruction.title: Add Task Instruction
add_task_instruction.description: Add or replace a titled instruction block appended to the system prompt.
